$comment: +++===+++ 2026-10-15 — Hasan Alizada — HAAL-160. Password policy (ADR-0005, NIST SP 800-63B / ASVS 5.0 V6): length 15..128 Unicode characters after NFKC, no composition rules, rejected if common, context-specific or trivially repetitive. Server is authoritative; the web app reuses the contract for live hints.
purpose: Checks a new password against the Haalendar password policy and returns every violated rule, so the UI can explain all problems at once.

email.description: Account e-mail; its local part must not appear in the password.

display_name.description: Name words of 4+ characters must not appear in the password.

violations.description: Violated rules in this fixed order: too_short, too_long, common, contains_email, contains_name, low_variety.

invariants: length is counted in Unicode code points after NFKC normalization
too_short when length < 15; too_long when length > 128
common when the lower-cased normalized password is in the bundled common-password list
contains_email when the e-mail local part has 4+ characters and occurs in the lower-cased password
contains_name when any display-name word of 4+ characters occurs in the lower-cased password
low_variety when the password has fewer than 5 distinct characters
valid is true exactly when violations is empty
no rule demands character classes (no composition rules)
